commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Importer compliance, procurement or supply-chain lead; actual authority remains unverified
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Polish-language exception resolution, fixed-scope ERP integration and accountable submission operations can differentiate, but incumbents can bundle all three and compete on price
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Prospective business after an importer signs the master services agreement and written representative mandate; no customer relationship is currently owned or contracted
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Founder-led paid evidence-gap diagnostic sold directly to one narrow importer segment, followed by a nonexclusive implementation and operating contract; broker and ERP referrals are optional rather than launch-critical

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Unvalidated planning range: 3,000-8,000 PLN of founder time, targeted outreach and presales effort per signed importer; abort the channel if two paid pilots imply CAC above first-year contribution
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Require 50% of fixed implementation fees at signature, 50% at configured acceptance, and monthly operating retainers prepaid; importer funds third-party remediation and pays pass-through usage charges to avoid financing supplier cleanup
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unvalidated target: 45-65% on implementation and 55-70% on recurring operations after delivery labor and usage costs; calculate by customer and do not scale until founder time, specialist review, insurance and support are included
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Planning assumption per initial importer: 40-80 hours for mapping, configuration, supplier templates and training, then 4-12 hours monthly for monitoring and exceptions; specialist legality or geospatial review is separately scoped or passed through
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Planning allowance: 30,000-60,000 PLN annually at early scale for legal updates, security tooling, professional-liability cover, audit logging and accounting, plus founder regulatory-maintenance time; actual quotations are unknown
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Paid diagnostic credited against a fixed implementation fee, then prepaid monthly workflow-operations retainer plus per-supplier activation or exceptional review charges; no fee is contingent on transferring the operator's legal responsibility
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Founder or contractor delivery labor, specialist review, geospatial and document-processing usage, translation, customer support and any referral fee; supplier remediation and extraordinary legal opinions remain customer-funded

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Existing EUDR vendors and ERP implementers can undercut software pricing, add local service partners or bundle authorised-representative workflows; defensibility therefore depends on low-cost narrow integrations and reliable operations under direct contracts, not proprietary supplier data
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Importer pays at a failed evidence-gap diagnostic, new supplier activation or recurring statement workload before covered goods are placed on or exported from the EU market
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: A dated EUDR obligation combined with an evidence gap, new supplier, ERP implementation need or insufficient internal operating capacity
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly prepaid operating renewal, with expansion at each new supplier, commodity or statement-volume band; retention remains unvalidated

economics.acquisition_route: Sell a prepaid evidence-gap diagnostic directly to Polish mid-market importers using Odoo or manual workflows; convert only diagnosed gaps into a signed fixed-scope integration and optional authorised-representative operating mandate
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated scenario: reach 30 customers averaging 60,000 PLN annual revenue at 20% fully loaded EBITDA, then 75 customers at the same average for 1.35m PLN EBITDA at 30%. At a hypothetical 4x multiple and majority founder ownership, business equity could exceed 5m PLN in years 6-9; CAC, capacity, churn, price and multiple are unknown, and founder cash is not double-counted.
economics.founder_time: Maximum 20-25 hours weekly while employed, concentrated on productization, sales and exception analytics; cap active pilots at two until delivery hours are measured, then use trained contractors for documented implementation and support
economics.gross_margin_basis: Collected diagnostic, implementation, retainer and activation revenue less all delivery labor at market rates, specialist review, usage charges, support, referral fees and customer-specific hosting; EBITDA additionally deducts security, insurance, legal updates and administration
economics.payback: Require each implementation deposit to cover initial third-party and contractor cash outlay; provisional acquisition payback gate is within six months of collected gross profit, but no candidate-specific payback evidence exists
economics.pricing: Test, not validated: 4,000-8,000 PLN prepaid diagnostic; 12,000-30,000 PLN fixed implementation; 1,500-4,000 PLN monthly prepaid operations plus 100-300 PLN per activated supplier or separately quoted expert exception
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring statement lifecycle, supplier and rule changes can support repeat usage, but annual retention is unproven; use a 12-month service proposal with monthly operating checkpoints and measure logo churn, supplier expansion and support hours

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable importer-owned integration adapters, exception playbooks and anonymized operating benchmarks, without assuming rights to a cross-customer supplier graph
fingerprint.customer: Polish mid-market operators importing covered commodities through Odoo or manual compliance workflows
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct prepaid evidence-gap diagnostics that convert into importer-specific workflow contracts; referrals are optional
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Productized EUDR workflow implementation and authorised-representative operations sold through fixed fees, prepaid retainers and supplier-activation charges
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator/importer pays for a diagnosed evidence gap, configured workflow, new supplier activation or recurring submission operations
fingerprint.problem_trigger: EUDR deadlines meet missing upstream geolocation and legality evidence

founder_fit: Document extraction, anomaly detection and workflow measurement fit the founder's data-science skills.
A prepaid diagnostic and no-code or light-integration first pilot can be run within the founder's capital and part-time limits.
The model uses targeted B2B outreach and documented delivery rather than camera-led distribution or continuous high-energy networking.

redesign.economic_effect: Replaces an unowned proprietary supplier-data subscription with prepaid importer-specific implementation and operating contracts. Deposits reduce working-capital exposure, pass-through exceptions cap variable-cost risk, and direct diagnostics remove reliance on unverified referral channels; expected margins are lower and more labor-sensitive than the parent assumption, while recurring retainers and standardized adapters preserve a possible productization path.

risks: No importer may buy from the prospective business despite the regulatory trigger.
Unsigned workflow and representative instruments may be refused or revoked, leaving only diagnostic revenue.
Supplier noncooperation can block completion even under an importer contract.
Commission production access, schemas and lifecycle rules remain externally controlled.
Incumbents can bundle equivalent workflows at lower software prices.
Delivery hours, professional liability, security and specialist-review costs may eliminate contribution margin.
Customer confidentiality may prevent reuse of data or benchmarks.
Regulatory simplification may reduce scope or urgency.

thesis: Future state: a narrow importer segment operates repeatable EUDR evidence and submission workflows without buying another generic data platform. The missing mechanism is a prepaid, importer-specific integration and operating contract that gives the prospective business a bounded workflow position while leaving source-data ownership and legal responsibility with the proper parties.
